annotations.text: Opens from the account row on Settings. Only the birthday for now - the identity card just anchors whose account it is. Day + month only, never a year.
Inline picker (recommended): the row expands in place; month chips 4x3, day grid 7 across, Save/Cancel. Day 29-31 grey out when the month is shorter.
Alternate: a bottom sheet with two wheels. More iOS, but wheels need custom scroll-snap work and read worse at this screen size.
